description: Demolition of the existing garage and side chimney, erection of a single storey side extension and installation of a front gate to the proposed side access alleyway to the rear garden
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unreferenced Location Plan; Unreferenced Block Plan; 01; 03  Received:  09 October 2019; Unreferenced Proposed Section (Rev B); 02 (Rev B)  Received:  25 November 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey side extension hereby approved.
